title: Why Bolsonaro says U.S. took him in: Trump ‘convinced’ Brazil is no longer a democracy
summary_full: After losing an election, sneaking to Miami and proclaiming himself rightful president, Flávio Bolsonaro says in an interview that the U.S. is a refuge where “institutions still work.”
summary_public: After losing an election, sneaking to Miami and proclaiming himself rightful president, Flávio Bolsonaro says in an interview that the U.S. is a refuge where “institutions still work.”
